description: Implementation of the WNPreferences class for the Wesnoth Scenario Editor, managing preferences such as terrain, unit, character selections, and UI elements.

classes.name: WNPreferences
classes.description: Class managing user preferences and UI elements for the Wesnoth Scenario Editor.

methods.name: setTerrainID
methods.description: Sets the ID of the selected terrain.

methods.name: getTerrain
methods.description: Returns the currently selected terrain object.

methods.name: getTerrainID
methods.description: Returns the ID of the selected terrain.

methods.name: setLoadIndicator
methods.description: Sets the load indicator UI element.

methods.name: getLoadIndicator
methods.description: Returns the load indicator UI element.

methods.name: fillWithTraitTags
methods.description: Fills a string with trait tag data based on the trait name.

methods.name: setUnitOpacity
methods.description: Sets the opacity level for units.

methods.name: getUnitOpacity
methods.description: Returns the opacity level for units.
